Definition: Elah, the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Elah = "An oak"; 1) an Edomite chief; 2) a king of Israel for two years, son of Baasha; 3) the father of king Hoshea of Israel; 4) a son of Caleb; 5) son of Uzzi
